h1: AI agent planning, so you start with the right task
overview: Not every task suits an agent, and a bad first choice wastes weeks. We look at how your team works, pick the tasks where an agent saves real time with low risk, and write down the goal, the tools it needs, the limits it must respect and how you will judge success. You get a plain-English plan you can act on, with or without us.

faq: Do I need to hire you to build the agent afterwards?
No. The plan is yours to keep and works with any developer. If you want us to build it, we can quote the build separately, using the plan as the scope.
What do you need from me?
A short description of the work, access to examples such as emails or tickets, and a call with whoever does the task today. We never need your passwords.
Will you tell me if an agent is a bad idea?
Yes. If a task is better done with a simple automation or by a person, we say so and explain why. Choosing not to build is a perfectly good outcome.
Does the plan include prices for AI usage?
It includes a rough estimate of what the tool and model usage might cost per month, based on your volumes. Real costs depend on the providers you choose and are billed to you directly.
